statement: For finite-dimensional accessible effect subspaces E_R,E_S, with join E_R+E_S and meet E_R intersect E_S, d(join)+d(meet)=d(R)+d(S). Equivalently, resource-relative accessible quotient dimension is a modular rank on the lattice of linear effect subspaces.
pdt_specific_role: resource-refinement and distinction-revelation bookkeeping; consistency/kill test

stress_tests.random_integer_families: 20 pairs per n in unit tests
